zh.summary: 把一項需求變更串到規格、設計、程式與驗證，保留修改理由及原本仍要成立的承諾。
objectives: 以小步變更說明本課規格驅動開發的工作方式。
為新增必要欄位盤點規格、介面、輸出及測試影響。
區分要求改變、實作修正與尚未驗證的結果。

readingGuide.goal: 以小步變更說明本課規格驅動開發的工作方式。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器、spec.md及工作坊reference/檔案，可先只閱讀；不需實際新增第四欄。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 spec.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: 一份可審查的C-02變更計畫，能由候選要求追到受影響檔案與待驗情境。

sections.heading: 規格要參與變更，而非寫完就封存
paragraphs: SDD（Spec-Driven Development，規格驅動開發）在本課指：以可討論、可版本控制的規格引導變更，再用實作與證據回頭核對。這是課程的工作定義，不宣稱所有工具採同一個標準流程，也不表示必須先寫完整套規格才能開始小步實作。
Cucumber的BDD方法強調具體例子與持續協作；OpenSpec也讓規格與變更文件在迭代中修訂。本課借這些方法說明如何維持一致，但保留它們各自的名稱、目的與工具差異。

sections.heading: 像修改食譜後同步採購與檢查
paragraphs: 如果餐點改為不含某項食材，食譜、採購單、製作步驟與出餐檢查都要相應更新。只改菜單名稱，廚房仍可能照舊製作；只換食材卻不改標示，也會造成誤解。
需求變更同樣會跨文件與程式。小步不是只改一個檔案，而是讓一項可說明的變更，在合理範圍內維持規格、介面、規則與驗證一致。

sections.heading: 先把第四欄視為候選變更
paragraphs: 合成提案C-02希望新增「收件批次代號」作第四個必要欄位。先確認用途、資料來源、型別、有效值與舊資料如何處理；本章只做影響分析，不修改三欄參考解答，也不宣稱提案已獲真實單位核准。
若課堂決定採用，可暫定沿既有字串規則作練習，但需在提案寫明這是教學決定，並確認輸出允許清單是否增加該欄。原本缺漏、空白、結果過期與不正式受理的約束仍要成立。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜候選第四欄的影響分析
rows: problem.md／spec.md
新增欄位的理由、定義、舊資料策略、正常與負向情境
只在聊天新增一行要求
wireframe.svg／介面
欄位名稱、必要提示、三欄完成文案及回復方式
只改欄位數字，漏掉說明
rules.py／輸出
必要欄位集合、型別與長度、匯出允許清單
只加文字輸入框
app.py／狀態
輸入變更使結果失效、預覽及下載仍對應目前資料
沿用可能過期的完成結果
tests/／交接
完整案例加入新欄、缺少新欄案例、舊情境回歸、README限制
把原測試刪掉或只更新預期值求綠燈

sections.heading: 由規格到驗證，再回到決定
paragraphs: 先記變更目的與影響，再修訂對應情境；實作時留下Diff（差異）供審查，執行針對性測試與仍受影響的回歸。發現規格不清時，可以回頭修改候選與設計，但要保留理由，不讓模型默默擴大責任。
NASA需求檢查表重視可追溯與驗證。本課用穩定需求代號連到情境、檔案與真實結果；連結存在本身還不是通過，必須能找到證據且範圍相符。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜一項規格變更的工作迴圈
blocks.description: 依序處理以便審查；學到新資訊時可回修，這不是一次通過後永不更改的瀑布階段。

items.title: 目的與影響
items.body: 記錄候選變更、負責角色、資料與相依範圍，保留尚未定義事項。

items.title: 條款與情境
items.body: 描述新行為及舊承諾，列完整、缺漏與過期結果案例。

items.title: 實作與審查
items.body: 在允許範圍修改，檢查Diff是否真的涵蓋規則與輸出。

items.title: 驗證與決定
items.body: 記真實測試結果及限制，決定接受、修正或暫緩，回填目前規格。

sections.heading: 分辨規格錯誤與程式偏離
paragraphs: 如果規格已確認「缺件不得完整匯出」，程式卻仍可下載，這是實作偏離，不能把規格改成允許缺件來消除失敗。若領域需求確實改變，才以明確提案修訂承諾，並重新檢查影響與責任。
測試全綠也可能因測錯、少測或預期值被改錯。審查者需核對情境、測試及程式的關係。例如新增第四欄後，原完整資料可能變成缺件；應區分要更新的測試資料與刻意保留的舊資料負向情境。

sections.heading: 留下可以追到實際檔案的紀錄
paragraphs: 現有參考專案確實有spec.md、rules.py、app.py與tests/test_rules.py／test_app.py；它們可用來練習影響盤點。下例寫的是計畫，不表示這些檔案已改成四欄，也沒有新增不存在的測試名稱來冒充通過證據。
常見誤解是「規格寫好了，Agent之後全部負責」。人類仍需確認規則、審查Diff及判斷證據是否足夠；Agent可協助編輯與執行，但不能自行把未知需求變成正式責任。

blocks.heading: 第四欄變更的紙上計畫
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 spec.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# C-02 候選：新增收件批次代號（未實作）
目的／來源：合成課堂情境，實際用途待確認
待決：有效值、舊資料策略、輸出欄位、確認角色
規格：補正常、缺少第四欄、空白、修改後過期情境
影響：spec.md、wireframe.svg、rules.py、app.py、tests/
既有約束：拒絕缺件完整匯出，結果對應目前輸入
驗證計畫：規則與介面測試、下載及鍵盤任務回歸
執行命令／結果：未執行，保持待驗
決定：先完成影響審查，再決定是否納入
界線：本課三欄參考解答沒有因這份計畫而改變

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器、spec.md及工作坊reference/檔案，可先只閱讀；不需實際新增第四欄。
steps: 為C-02寫目的、未決規則與確認角色，標為候選提案。
逐一盤點規格、線框稿、規則、介面、輸出與測試影響，補一條缺少第四欄的候選負向情境。
比較哪些既有資料需更新、哪些應保留為舊資料負向案例，將未執行的驗證計畫留在變更紀錄。
exercise.expected: 一份可審查的C-02變更計畫，能由候選要求追到受影響檔案與待驗情境。
exercise.check: 沒有把三欄參考解答誤寫為已修改；能區分需求變更與為求測試通過而改要求。
exercise.cleanup: 保留原始參考專案，紙上計畫使用合成資料；未授權或未決項目不自行啟用。

en.summary: Connect a requirement change to specification, design, code and verification, retaining its reason and commitments that must still hold.
objectives: Explain the course’s spec-driven workflow through a small change.
Identify specification, interface, output and test impacts of an added required field.
Distinguish changed requirements, implementation corrections and unverified results.

readingGuide.goal: Explain the course’s spec-driven workflow through a small change.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor, spec.md and workshop reference/ files, initially read-only; no fourth-field implementation is required.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand spec.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A reviewable C-02 change plan connecting a candidate requirement to affected files and pending scenarios.

sections.heading: Keep the Specification Involved in Changes
paragraphs: In this course, Spec-Driven Development (SDD) uses discussable, version-controlled specifications to guide changes, then checks them against implementation and evidence. This is a course working definition, not a universal tool standard or a requirement to finish every specification before implementing a small slice.

Cucumber’s BDD emphasizes examples and continued collaboration; OpenSpec also revises specification and change artifacts iteratively. The course uses these ideas for consistency while retaining their separate names, purposes and tools.

sections.heading: Update Purchasing and Checks When a Recipe Changes
paragraphs: Removing an ingredient from a meal affects the recipe, purchase list, preparation and serving checks. A changed menu alone may leave old cooking practices; swapping ingredients without labeling also confuses people.

Requirement changes likewise span documents and code. A small step is one explainable, reasonably bounded change keeping specification, interface, rules and verification consistent, not necessarily one edited file.

sections.heading: Treat the Fourth Field as a Candidate First
paragraphs: Synthetic proposal C-02 adds “intake batch code” as a fourth required field. Clarify purpose, source, type, valid values and old-data treatment first. This lesson analyzes impact only: it does not change the three-field reference or claim actual organizational approval.

If the class adopts it, existing string rules can be a provisional teaching choice. Record that decision and confirm whether the output allowlist gains the field. Missing-input, whitespace, stale-result and no-official-acceptance constraints still apply.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Impact Analysis for a Proposed Fourth Field
rows: problem.md / spec.md
Reason, definition, old-data policy, normal and negative scenarios.
A new sentence in chat only.
wireframe.svg / interface
Name, required guidance, three-field completion wording and recovery.
Changing the field count without explanations.
rules.py / output
Required-field set, types, lengths and output allowlist.
Only adding a text input.
app.py / state
Edits invalidate results; preview/download match current input.
Reusing potentially stale completion.
tests/ / handoff
New field in valid input, a missing-new-field case, regressions and README limits.
Deleting old tests or changing expected values solely for green results.

sections.heading: Move from Specification to Verification and Back to Decisions
paragraphs: Record purpose/impact, revise scenarios, then retain the implementation diff for review. Run targeted tests and affected regressions. Unclear specifications can lead back to proposal/design changes, with reasons retained rather than silent model expansion of responsibility.

NASA’s checklist emphasizes traceability and verification. Stable requirement IDs connect scenarios, files and actual results. Links alone are not a pass: evidence must exist and match the claim’s scope.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | The Work Loop for One Specification Change
blocks.description: The order supports review; new information can lead back to revisions. These are not immutable waterfall phases.

items.title: Purpose and impact
items.body: Record candidate change, responsible role, data/dependency scope and unresolved definitions.

items.title: Clauses and scenarios
items.body: Describe new behavior and retained commitments through complete, missing-input and stale-result cases.

items.title: Implementation and review
items.body: Change within allowed scope and inspect the diff for rules and output coverage.

items.title: Verification and decision
items.body: Record actual results and limits; accept, revise or defer, updating the current specification.

sections.heading: Distinguish Specification Errors from Implementation Drift
paragraphs: If confirmed rules prohibit complete export for missing input but code permits download, fix implementation drift. Do not rewrite the requirement to erase failure. Actual domain changes need explicit proposals, review and renewed impact/responsibility checks.

Green tests can result from incorrect, missing or wrongly updated checks. Review links among scenarios, tests and code. After adding a fourth field, formerly valid input may become incomplete: distinguish fixtures needing updates from old-data negative cases deliberately retained.

sections.heading: Connect the Plan to Actual Files
paragraphs: The reference contains spec.md, rules.py, app.py and tests/test_rules.py / test_app.py for impact review. The plan below does not claim four-field edits or invent test names as passing evidence.

A common mistake is transferring every responsibility to the agent once a specification exists. People still confirm rules, review diffs and assess evidence. Agents can edit and execute without authority to turn unknown needs into official responsibilities.

blocks.heading: Tabletop Plan for the Fourth Field
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese C-02 template records an unimplemented synthetic proposal, purpose/source, unresolved values/old-data/output/owner decisions, new scenarios, affected files, retained constraints, planned verification and an unexecuted status. The three-field reference remains unchanged; adapt this plan without inventing actual approvals or findings.

待決：有效值、舊資料策略、輸出欄位、確認角色
規格：補正常、缺少第四欄、空白、修改後過期情境

exercise.environment: A text editor, spec.md and workshop reference/ files, initially read-only; no fourth-field implementation is required.
steps: Write C-02 purpose, unresolved rules and confirming role, labeling it a candidate proposal.
Review specification, wireframe, rules, interface, output and test impacts; add a proposed negative case missing the fourth field.
Distinguish data to update from old-data negative cases to retain. Keep unexecuted verification plans in the change record.
exercise.expected: A reviewable C-02 change plan connecting a candidate requirement to affected files and pending scenarios.
exercise.check: Do not describe the three-field reference as modified. Distinguish a real requirement change from weakening commitments to make tests pass.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the original reference project. Use synthetic data and do not activate undecided or unauthorized work.

zh.prompt: 本章SDD最主要維持哪種關係？
options: 只要規格字數越多越好
規格、實作與驗證隨變更保持可追溯的一致
先把所有功能一次產生
文件與測試可以互不相關
rationales: 數量不能代替可驗收性。
變更目的、行為與證據需要互相核對。
不符合小步修正與審查。
會讓偏離難以被發現。

en.prompt: What relationship does this lesson’s SDD maintain?
options: More specification words are always better.
Specifications, implementation and verification stay traceably consistent through changes.
Generate all features at once.
Documentation and tests need not relate.
rationales: Volume cannot replace verifiability.
Purpose, behavior and evidence must be checked together.
This bypasses small changes and review.
Drift becomes difficult to detect.

zh.prompt: 新增第四個必要欄位，最需要避免什麼？
options: 保留變更理由
補新欄缺漏案例
檢查輸出允許清單
只加輸入框，卻未更新規則、完成文案與測試
rationales: 理由有助追溯。
負向情境支援驗收。
輸出契約也可能受影響。
介面出現欄位不代表規格與驗證已同步。

en.prompt: What should be avoided when adding a fourth required field?
options: Retain the change reason.
Add a missing-new-field case.
Inspect the output allowlist.
Add only an input without updating rules, completion wording and tests.
rationales: Reasons support traceability.
Negative scenarios support acceptance.
The output contract may also change.
A visible field does not synchronize specification and verification.

zh.prompt: 程式違反已確認的缺件匯出規則時，應如何處理？
options: 直接把規格改成允許缺件
刪掉失敗測試
先辨識實作偏離並修正；真正需求改變另走明確提案與審查
只更新README寫已完成
rationales: 不能用改承諾掩蓋程式錯誤。
失敗可能指出真實偏離，不應為綠燈刪除。
分開問題類型，才能保留規則與變更責任。
文件宣告不會改變實際行為。

en.prompt: Code violates a confirmed missing-input export rule. What next?
options: Rewrite the spec to permit missing data.
Delete the failing test.
Identify and correct implementation drift; actual requirement changes need separate explicit proposals and review.
Only update README to say complete.
rationales: Changing commitments must not conceal code errors.
Failure may reveal real drift; do not remove it for green results.
Separating problem types retains rule and change responsibility.
A documentation claim does not change behavior.
